title: Enable partial restore operations with tenant quarantine mode
author: Maya Chen
ci_checks: e2e: pass (fixed intermittent timing in restore controller)
description: This PR introduces a controlled partial-restore flow and a tenant-quarantine mode to reduce blast radius when rolling back or restoring subsets of a Private deployment. Motivation: larger clusters with multi-tenant namespaces sometimes only need a targeted restore (single tenant, small time window) but existing restore tooling required full-cluster restores or manual fencing. This change adds: 1) a partial restore controller that accepts a tenant selector and a point-in-time snapshot reference, performs namespace-scoped restore of resources and PVCs, and wires into existing restore verification hooks; 2) a tenant-quarantine mode that temporarily isolates restored tenant namespaces from inbound routing and cross-tenant scheduling until integrity checks pass; 3) a helm chart patch set to expose the new controller and quarantine feature gates; 4) terraform module updates to make snapshot references and quarantine toggles configurable for private installs; 5) migration helpers to pin compatible operator/controller versions during restore to avoid schema drift. The design prioritizes safe automated restores: the controller stages resources in an isolated namespace, replays PV binds with transactional checks, runs schema compatibility checks against the target operator image, and only flips network policies when health checks and sample evals succeed. Rollback/upgrade considerations: the controller records an idempotent restore plan and a reversible quarantine marker so operators can abort or re-run without leaving dangling networking rules. Security: restored secrets are re-encrypted with cluster KMS keys when the cluster key differs from snapshot keys. Testing: unit tests for controller logic, integration tests on KIND and an internal on-prem harness with mocked blockstore snapshots, and a validation e2e that runs sanity traffic through the quarantine gate. Rollout: feature is gated off by default; enable via Helm values.quarantine.enabled and terraform variables. Docs: added an operations playbook for partial restores, runbook steps for aborting, and example terraform snippets. Backwards compatibility: existing full-restore paths are unchanged. This PR is intended to reduce restore time, lower blast radius for tenant-scoped incidents, and provide safer automated rollback paths for Private deployments.

release_notes: Add partial restore controller and tenant-quarantine mode: allow namespace-scoped restores from snapshots, isolate restored tenants until health checks pass, configurable via Helm and Terraform. Includes migration guidance for terraform state and notes on KMS re-encryption.
notes_for_ops: Enable behind feature gate: values.quarantine.enabled=true. For large clusters prefer snapshot subsetters and pre-warming PVCs. Abort flow: call restorecontroller abort API with plan id; controller will rollback staged resources and clear quarantine marker.
qa_summary: Unit tests: pass. Integration: ran against internal on-prem harness with blockstore emulator. E2E: validated quarantine gating prevents ingress during restore and releases after health checks. Observed one intermittent readiness timing issue fixed in follow-up commit.
notes: Feature gated, non-breaking by default. Operators should test restores in a staging cluster before enabling in production.
